subject: afi-dy
title: (R)AFI.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-31 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the significance of a composite affinity alignment would have to do with an expanded basis for viewing information … the solidification of an expanded affinity stance would move to realign every segment of western and world culture.' (R)AFI-DY (the reality of affinity-insight dynamics) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information): the question is what affinity-insight-dynamics produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with multi-information. INFO-DE (information degrees) branches from the main line and carries (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition). A *dashed* line from the main line leads to (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction) — the dotted line amplifying some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. From the (R)ATTN line, DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) branches and carries PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and AFN (affinity negation). AFI-DY appears a second time on the lower-right, at the end of a line from AFN, and carries (R)POST (the reality of postulation).
